assessment: B · isolated source-only detector and technical audit
scoreLimits: Source-level scores only. No screenshots, design-review output, browser, rendered contrast, real touch, or performance trace were viewed. Runtime coverage belongs to the independent coverage agent.
integrityVerdict: Coherent existing Party implementation using actual shared primitives and existing role-action handlers; no deterministic detector drift. Several inherited local accessibility/typography gaps remain.

problems.evidence: T7/T12 and design guide §§20/30: detail tabs declare tablist/tab/aria-selected but have no roving tabIndex, arrow/Home/End handler, ids, aria-controls or associated tabpanel. Same pattern at PartyDetailResponsive.tsx:396. MotionTabList.tsx explicitly supplies presentation only. Directory role filters repeat role=tab without tab keyboard semantics (PartyDirectory.tsx:36 and PartyDirectoryResponsive.tsx:60). Every tab is an ordinary Tab stop; arrow keys do not move between the advertised tabs. This is inherited source behavior, not a detector hit.
problems.fix: Add local ids/panel associations and complete roving keyboard behavior to content tabs in both detail variants. For role filters use a semantic labelled pressed-button group, or implement a complete tab pattern. Preserve handlers, labels, selections and layouts.

problems.evidence: T7 and design guide §30: desktop directory declares role=listbox with role=option buttons, but has no arrow/Home/End navigation or single active tab stop. Responsive directory adds arrows at lines 35–44, but still leaves every option tabbable. Screen readers announce a composite selection widget while focus behavior is an ordinary long button list. Inherited behavior; selection callbacks are real and must remain.
problems.fix: Use a complete local single-select listbox focus model, preserving Enter/Space selection and selected identity, or use ordinary list/button semantics with a current/pressed state. Keep existing responsive search-to-results behavior and focus return.

problems.evidence: T7/T9 and design guide §§7/14: failed validation only sets one bottom role=alert and returns; amount, discount/reason and splits get no error id association/aria-invalid and focus stays on Review/Confirm. Refund (PartyCreditRefundDialog.tsx:43–49,77–88,97), finance (PartyFinanceDialog.tsx:51–60,84,105) and opening (PartyOpeningDialog.tsx:77–90) repeat this. Labels and live alert do exist; missing field association/focus is the verified gap. No accounting validation change is requested.
problems.fix: Expose current validation errors on the existing affected inputs with aria-invalid and aria-describedby plus stable error ids; focus the relevant invalid input or existing error summary after failed review. Preserve existing validators and payloads.

problems.evidence: T4/T7/T12: note Edit/Delete use raw buttons with 14px icons plus p-1, approximately 22px boxes, and only gap-1. Duplicate desktop code is PartyDetail.tsx:380–381. Shared 36px .hisabiq-button size rules in index.css:616 do not cover these raw buttons. This violates the product ordinary icon-action contract and makes adjacent routine actions harder to tap. The 4px spacing may satisfy WCAG target-spacing exception; no blanket WCAG 44px claim is made.
problems.fix: Reuse shared Button size=icon with existing ghost/destructive semantic styling and translated accessible labels, retaining exact edit/delete callbacks and dialog focus behavior. Keep 36px contract; avoid a global default edit.

problems.evidence: T5 and design guide §5 require proportional money figures. Desktop balance applies tabular-nums outside any data-erp-table/data-erp-table-view marker, so index.css:783–795 table numeric reset does not protect it. Responsive counterpart does not have tabular-nums. Inherited source drift, not an official detector finding.
problems.fix: Remove local tabular-nums from the desktop directory balance; preserve currency formatting, semantic colors and exact amount.

intentionalOrOverriddenPatterns: Detector raw output is []; there are no detector hits to suppress.
36px controls are the explicit owner contract; generic audit preference for 44px targets does not authorize enlargement.
teal-* and ink-* classes map to runtime theme channels in tailwind.config.js and src/theme.css; they are not hard-coded palette violations.
Legacy text-[11px]/text-[15px] on marked table rows is overridden by high-specificity 13/12/11 roles in src/index.css:783–810; do not report those class strings as rendered typography defects.

LedgerTableResponsive deliberately uses the inherited phone row composition below 768px and a scrollable table from 768px. Sticky-right row action cells preserve access; runtime bounds remain for the coverage agent.

Truncated ledger descriptions retain full description through the real view/source preview; directory identity opens the actual detail. Do not remove those behaviors or redesign layouts on a generic anti-truncation recommendation.

Statements generate a real CSV Blob/download and call the established print path. Customer/Supplier/payment/refund and Owner/Lender/Borrower role finance flows retain existing role mappings and source handlers.
Shared Table supplies keyboard scrolling only when overflow exists; source min-width alone is not proof of inaccessible table scrolling.
positiveFindings: Search/date/filter/reset are controlled; mobile and tablet toggles intentionally preserve visible DOM order.
Existing shared Dialog, Input, Button, AppSelect, Table, FloatingPanel and ActionMenu are reused; role-action map is intact.
Money uses existing currency helpers and right-aligned cells; source previews expose full references/descriptions.
Mobile ledger transitions honor useReducedMotion. No expensive animation/layout-thrashing issue was verified.
Actions explicitly distinguish UI preview from real posting; unavailable SMS is intentionally disabled with reason.
openQuestions: Coverage agent must validate large amounts/long Bangla and 200% text zoom, menu/dialog focus return, split fields and on-screen keyboard bounds, print output and light/dark contrast. No runtime success is inferred from this source audit.
knownCheckContext: Coordinator reports full baseline lint fails only in newly initialized upstream vendor/super-board (58 errors); authored lint uses --ignore-pattern vendor/super-board/** and the original failure must be disclosed. This auditor did not rerun or alter that baseline.
